signals.title: USD/SEK — G10 Bilateral Theme + ESI Divergence
signals.text: USD/SEK trades with a notable G10 performance gap as USD outperforms the G10 aggregate by +0.421% (n=9) while SEK lags at −0.597% (n=2), yielding a 1.018% leader-to-laggard spread. Fed on hold at 3.75% vs Riksbank at 1.75% maintains a 200bp rate differential supporting the dollar. Macro fundamentals reinforce this divergence, with Sweden's Economic Surprise Index at a strong negative −22.6 following Sweden's CPI print of 0.3% y/y against 0.4% expected. USD/SEK trades at 9.689, holding above its SMA20/50/200 cluster at 9.552/9.588/9.347 in a bullish technical alignment. Trade bias: Long USD/SEK; broad macroeconomic divergence and carry favor continued upside. Catalyst: Riksbank policy decision on 24 Sep — hold at 1.75% expected. Risk: Leader-to-laggard spread compresses below 0.80%, signaling an unwinding of the bilateral G10 trend.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Options Skew vs Carry Support
signals.text: USD/JPY trades at 154.596, holding below its SMA20/50/200 cluster at 157.62/159.69/158.41. BoJ holds at 1.0%. The 25d Risk Reversal prints at −2.09, showing a strong put skew as the options market pays up for downside protection against potential policy tightening. ATM 1M IV sits at 9.5% against HV30 of 9.3%, reflecting a minimal +0.2% vol risk premium. While retail sentiment is 82% long, CFTC speculative positioning shows Leveraged Funds net short −53,255 contracts (30th percentile), limiting immediate positioning unwinds until 160.00 verbal intervention levels are retested. Trade bias: Neutral/cautious USD/JPY; elevated options downside skew offsets positive carry. Catalyst: BoJ Rate Decision on 18 Sep — market evaluating potential hike to 1.25%. Risk: Break above SMA20 at 157.62 forcing short covering toward 160.00.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Positioning Crowding + Carry Premium
signals.text: AUD/USD trades at 0.7132, remaining above its SMA20/50/200 cluster at 0.7168/0.7069/0.7003. CFTC Leveraged Funds net positioning sits at +48,379 contracts, placing positioning at the 93rd percentile of its 52-week range (z = +1.72), indicating a crowded spec long. OIS differentials favor AUD with AONIA at 4.35% vs SOFR at 3.62% (−73bp carry advantage for AUD), backed by RBA at 4.35% vs Fed at 3.75%. However, retail positioning shows an extreme 74% short stance, creating institutional-versus-retail divergence near the top of the historical range. 1M IV runs at 7.2% against HV30 of 6.1%, reflecting a +1.0% vol risk premium. Trade bias: Long AUD/USD; net carry premium and technical posture support upside despite crowded institutional longs. Catalyst: RBA policy meeting on 29 Sep — hold expected. Risk: AUD LF net positioning liquidates below +40,000 contracts, triggering a late-trend long unwind.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Yield Differential + Vol Premium
signals.text: EUR/USD trades at 1.1550, positioned below its SMA20 at 1.1630 and SMA200 at 1.1637, but holding above the SMA50 at 1.1532. The OIS CIP carry differential shows SOFR 3.62% vs €STR 2.19% (+143bp favoring USD), while 10Y Bunds yield 3.50% vs US 10Y at 4.96% (-146bp spread). Options data shows 1M ATM IV at 5.1% against HV30 at 4.3%, generating a +0.8% vol risk premium, while the 25d Risk Reversal is neutral at −0.11. CFTC Leveraged Funds hold a net short of −46,381 contracts (34th percentile), reflecting modest bearish spec sentiment that aligns with structural rate headwinds. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD; monetary policy rate differentials and yield spreads constrain upside. Catalyst: Fed rate decision on 16 Sep followed by ECB President Lagarde speech today at 15:15 UTC. Risk: Break above the SMA20/200 technical resistance cluster at 1.1630/1.1637.

signals.title: USD/CHF — Complacency Vol Premium + Carry Advantage
signals.text: USD/CHF trades at 0.8167, maintaining a bullish technical alignment above its SMA20/50/200 cluster at 0.8074/0.8093/0.7934. The Fed policy rate of 3.75% vs SNB at 0.00% maintains a +375bp nominal carry spread in favor of the dollar, while SARON at -0.04% vs SOFR at 3.62% preserves the OIS carry advantage. Volatility metrics highlight unusual pricing: 1M ATM IV sits at 6.8% vs HV30 of 7.4%, resulting in a negative Vol Risk Premium of −0.6%. CFTC positioning shows Leveraged Funds net short CHF at −13,968 contracts (12th percentile, z = −1.09), confirming persistent spec short bias against the franc. Trade bias: Long USD/CHF; deep carry advantage and bullish moving average alignment support the pair. Catalyst: SNB monetary policy assessment on 24 Sep — hold at 0.00% expected. Risk: Reversion in implied vol forcing risk-off unwinds across high-carry CHF pairs.
